source_data.IndustryName: Electrical Machinery, Devices, Equipments and Parts
source_data.Description: A VPI Dry Type Transformer is a dry type electrical transformer whose windings are thoroughly treated using the Vacuum Pressure Impregnation (VPI) process. Unlike oil-filled transformers, it uses air for cooling and insulation, and its windings have resin deeply impregnated into them through a vacuum and pressure cycle to create a highly reliable, moisture-resistant, mechanically strong insulation system.
source_data.KeyWords: VPI dry type transformer, Vacuum Pressure Impregnated transformer, dry type distribution transformer, air-cooled transformer, Class H insulation transformer.

source_data.IndustryName: Electrical Machinery, Devices, Equipments and Parts
source_data.Description: An Iron Core Dry Type Transformer is a type of electrical transformer used to change voltage levels in power distribution systems without using liquid (oil) for cooling or insulation. Its iron core, usually made from laminated grain-oriented silicon steel sheets, forms the magnetic circuit that couples the primary and secondary windings. The windings and core are cooled by air (natural or forced) and insulated with high-temperature resin or materials, making the transformer fire-safe, environmentally friendly, and suitable for indoor use.
source_data.KeyWords: Iron core dry type transformer, dry type distribution transformer, air-cooled transformer, cast resin dry transformer, silicon steel core transformer, indoor transformer.

source_data.IndustryName: Electrical Machinery, Devices, Equipments and Parts
source_data.Description: The 500 kVA 3-Phase Dry Type Unitized Substation is a compact, factory-assembled power distribution solution that integrates HT switchgear, a dry type transformer, and an LT distribution panel into a single enclosed unit. It is designed for safe, reliable, and space-efficient power distribution, especially suited for indoor installations and fire-sensitive environments.

source_data.IndustryName: Electrical Machinery, Devices, Equipments and Parts
source_data.Description: An Automatic Step Voltage Transformer is a power control device designed to automatically step up or step down input voltage to maintain a stable and safe output voltage. It continuously monitors voltage fluctuations and adjusts the output using automatic tap changing or servo control mechanisms, ensuring reliable operation of electrical equipment without manual intervention.
source_data.KeyWords: Automatic step voltage transformer, automatic voltage transformer, step up step down transformer, automatic tap changing transformer, servo voltage transformer.

source_data.IndustryName: Electrical Machinery, Devices, Equipments and Parts
source_data.Description: A Vacuum Circuit Breaker (VCB) is a medium-voltage switching device used to protect electrical systems from overloads and short circuits. It uses vacuum as the arc-quenching medium, which provides fast arc extinction, high dielectric strength, and long service life. VCBs are widely used in industrial plants, substations, power distribution networks, and commercial installations.
source_data.KeyWords: Vacuum circuit breaker, VCB breaker, 11kV vacuum circuit breaker, indoor VCB, outdoor VCB, medium voltage circuit breaker, electrical protection breaker, power distribution VCB.

source_data.CategoryName: Bolts - Alloy, Metal and High Strength Bolts
source_data.Description: CSK Slot Head Bolts are precision fasteners designed with a countersunk (CSK) head and a straight slot drive. These bolts are commonly used in applications where surface protrusion is not desired, such as furniture, machinery, electrical fittings, and architectural installations.

source_data.CategoryName: Bolts - Alloy, Metal and High Strength Bolts
source_data.Description: Hex Bolts and Screws are essential mechanical fasteners designed to securely join two or more components together. Featuring a six-sided (hexagonal) head, they allow easy tightening and loosening using standard spanners or wrenches. Widely used in construction, machinery, automotive, industrial, and engineering applications, hex bolts and screws provide strong, reliable, and long-lasting fastening solutions.
source_data.KeyWords: Hex Bolt, Hex Screw, Hex Head Bolt, Hex Head Screw, Industrial Bolts, Stainless Steel Hex Bolt, MS Hex Bolt, High Tensile Hex Bolt.

source_data.CategoryName: Nuts - Alloy, Metal and Industrial Nuts
source_data.Description: Lock Nuts are specially designed fasteners used to prevent loosening of bolted joints caused by vibration, shock, or dynamic loads. Unlike standard nuts, lock nuts provide additional resistance to rotation, ensuring a secure and long-lasting fastening. They are commonly used in machinery, automotive, construction, and industrial applications where safety and reliability are critical.
source_data.KeyWords: Lock Nut, Self Locking Nut, Nylon Lock Nut, All Metal Lock Nut, Flange Lock Nut, Jam Nut, Anti Vibration Nut.

source_data.CategoryName: Bolts - Alloy, Metal and High Strength Bolts
source_data.Description: Carriage Bolts are specially designed fasteners featuring a smooth, rounded (domed) head and a square neck beneath the head. The square neck locks into place during installation, preventing the bolt from rotating when the nut is tightened. Commonly used in wood-to-wood and wood-to-metal connections, carriage bolts provide a secure, tamper-resistant, and aesthetically clean fastening solution.
source_data.KeyWords: Carriage Bolt, Coach Bolt, Round Head Bolt, Square Neck Bolt, Wood Bolt, Furniture Bolt, Timber Fastener, Galvanized Carriage Bolt.

source_data.CategoryName: Nuts - Alloy, Metal and Industrial Nuts
source_data.Description: Nylock Nuts are self-locking fasteners designed with a nylon insert at the top of the nut, which increases friction on the bolt threads and prevents loosening due to vibration or movement. They provide a secure and reliable locking solution without the need for additional locking devices such as spring washers or lock washers. Nylock nuts are widely used in automotive, machinery, electrical, and structural applications.
source_data.KeyWords: Nylock Nut, Nylon Insert Nut, Lock Nut, Self Locking Nut, Hex Nylock Nut, Stainless Steel Nylock Nut, Galvanized Nylock Nut.

source_data.CategoryName: Nuts - Alloy, Metal and Industrial Nuts
source_data.Description: Hex Nuts are widely used mechanical fasteners with a six-sided shape that allows easy tightening and loosening using standard spanners or wrenches. source_data.KeyWords: Hex Nut, Nut Bolt, Hexagonal Nut, MS Hex Nut, Stainless Steel Hex Nut, High Tensile Nut, Galvanized Hex Nut.

source_data.Description: Plain Washers are flat, circular metal discs with a central hole, used to distribute the load of a nut or bolt over a larger surface area. source_data.CategoryName: Washers - Metal, Alloy and Machine Washers
source_data.Description: Spring Washers are specially designed fasteners used to prevent loosening of nuts and bolts caused by vibration, shock, or dynamic loads. Their split and helically formed design creates a spring action that maintains tension in the joint, ensuring a secure and reliable fastening. source_data.Description: A CPVC Reducing Bush is a plumbing fitting used to connect two CPVC (Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride) pipes of different diameters when one pipe needs to be reduced to a smaller size within the same fitting connection.
